text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer sentences with multiple clauses","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"Uses more extended sentence structures that combine several ideas within a single sentence."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"Also,\" \"In addition,\" and \"Overall,\"","quality":"organizational control","description":"Shows clearer paragraph and discourse organization with explicit transitions and a more essay-like progression."},{"evidence":"repeated reference to \"self-esteem,\" \"self confidence,\" and \"achievements\"","quality":"idea development","description":"Develops the central idea with more supporting explanation and elaboration across the essay."},{"evidence":"\"That being said, now I can speak, write and read very well\"","quality":"range of expression","description":"Uses a wider range of phrasing to express personal experience and argument beyond simple narration."},{"evidence":"\"achieve their goals,\" \"build their self-esteem\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"Uses more abstract school-argument vocabulary that fits the task more effectively."}]}
